entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The allegation against the appellant and others is of wrongly executed the sale deed of 2 Acre 10 Katha instead of 10 Katha from the informant.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the appellant that appellant has been falsely implicated in this case.
The present dispute relates to civil matter.
He has not taken the caste name of the informant in public view.
No offence is made out under the provisions of the SC/ST Act against him.
The appellant has no intention to disgrace the image of the informant in public view.
The appeal for bail is opposed by learned Spl. P.P. for the State.
Having heard learned counsel for the parties and taking into consideration, the Court is inclined to allow this appeal.
Accordingly, the appeal is allowed and the impugned order dated 13.10.2022 arising out of Paraiya P.S. Case No. 161 of 2022 is hereby set aside.

The appellant is directed to be enlarged on bail in Patna High Court CR. APP (SJ) No.4097 of 2022(2) dt.23-03-2023 connection with Paraiya P.S. Case No. 161 of 2022 on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Rs. ten thousand only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Exclusive Special Judge SC/ST, Gaya.
